name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: dimension
label: Report
help: What to rank: pages, sources, countries and more. For a custom event property, leave this and fill in Custom Property.

name: custom_property
label: Custom Property
help: Optional. A custom event property key, like plan. When filled in, the report ranks the values of that property and Report is ignored.

name: period
label: Period
help: Date range preset, in the site's timezone: today, yesterday, 24h (last 24 hours), 7d, 14d, 28d, 30d, 90d (the last N days), mtd (month to date), last_month, qtd (quarter to date), last_quarter, ytd (year to date), 12mo, last_year, all (all time), or custom (then the range is from to to)

name: from
label: From
help: First day of the range as YYYY-MM-DD, in the site's timezone. Only used when period is custom. Without it the range starts 29 days before to

name: to
label: To
help: Last day of the range as YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Only used when period is custom. Without it the range ends today

name: compare
label: Compare
help: Also compute a comparison range: previous_period (the same length right before), previous_year (the same dates a year earlier), custom (needs both compare_from and compare_to) or none. Adds the comparison values and the percent change to the result

name: filters
label: Filters
help: Filters that must all match: a list of [dimension, operator, value] conditions, e.g. [["country","is","US"],["page","starts_with","/blog"]]. Dimensions: channel, referrer, referrer_url, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, ref, hostname, country, language, device, browser, browser_version, os, os_version, screen, entry_page, exit_page, interaction, bot_score, page, event, goal, prop:<key>. Use the exact singular names (country, not countries). Values are as stored: country is a two-letter code such as US, channel is a name such as organic_search, a page is a path such as /pricing. Operators taking one value: is, is_not, contains, not_contains, starts_with, wildcard and not_wildcard (the value uses * as a wildcard, e.g. /blog/*), regex and not_regex (a Postgres regular expression of up to 200 characters), gt and lt (a number). any_of and none_of take a list: ["country","any_of",["US","DE"]]. between takes two numbers: ["prop:price","between",[10,50]]. For OR, wrap conditions in an object: {"any":[["channel","is","email"],["utm_medium","is","email"]]}. Up to 20 conditions.

name: segment_id
label: Segment
help: Apply a saved segment by its id (seg_…, from segments_list). Its filters are added to filters

name: sort
label: Sort
help: Metric to sort by, highest first. Default is the main count of the dimension: visitors for visit dimensions, pageviews for page, completions for event, goal and prop:<key>

name: search
label: Search
help: Only rows whose value contains this text, in any letter case. It searches every value, not just the top rows. Not for goal

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of results Make returns during one execution cycle.
